parameters.note: Lower Velma Lake is a high-alpine lake (~7,760 ft) in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), the lowest of the three Velma Lakes. Unlike Middle Velma (which drains west toward the headwaters of the Rubicon River / American River watershed), the Upper and Lower Velma lakes drain east via Eagle Creek to Emerald Bay on Lake Tahoe, so Lower Velma lies within the Lake Tahoe basin — but well upstream of the 'first lake.' The special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152), which reaches only flowing tributaries upstream to the first lake) therefore does not apply to this lake. It is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1) governs: open all year, 5/10. It is not in CDFW's 2026 provisional stocking plan; brook, rainbow, and brown trout ('Brookies, Rainbows, and Browns') are reported by a third-party angling reference (flyfishingthesierra.com).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
